name: Miyamae Iroha
source:
A girl with arrogant attitude.
She is the frontman of a famous idol group "Three Peace" who attends the school. Having beautiful appearance, she is extremely good at dancing and singing.
On the surface she is affable and sociable, but in fact she is selfish and calculating.
She somewhat despises her fans.
